The judge's explanation, as written

Both parties: this is NO_ACTION on the rider's route-deviation claim. It turns on the threshold in POL-RD-01, not on anyone's characterisation of the trip. RIDER — your measurement is right but it does not clear the clause. The governing distance is the trace figure, gps_trace.trace_distance_km = 14.84 km on EV-GPS-02806, which governs over the rounded trip_record.actual_distance_km = 14.8 km exactly as POL-RD-01 requires; had the rounded copy been used the excess would read 0.80 km. Against the booked optimal of 14.00 km (trip_record, EV-TRIP-02806) the excess is 0.84 km, i.e. 6.00% of optimal (derived.deviation on EV-GPS-02806). POL-RD-01 establishes a deviation only where the excess is BOTH greater than 20% of optimal (here 2.80 km) AND greater than 0.8 km absolute. The absolute limb passes at 0.84 km, but the percentage limb fails by a wide margin, and the two limbs are conjunctive. No deviation is established. Your POL-RD-02 computation (charged_total 21.10; recomputed_fare 20.3920; refund 0.7080, rounded up to SGD 0.75) is arithmetic I have verified but it never runs, because POL-RD-01 gates it and the gate has not opened. Your POL-RD-08(a) identity showing is accepted — trip_record, gps_trace and fare_breakdown all carry TRP-02806 and the trace's first fix at 2026-09-11T17:19:44+08:00 matches trip_record.started_at — but POL-RD-08(b) fails for the same threshold reason, so the burden never shifts to the driver. Your profile point is accepted: deviation_claims_60d and deviation_claims_60d_substantiated are citable for the POL-RD-08 test and, at 0 and 0 on EV-RPROF-02806, the heightened-corroboration condition does not bite; no adverse inference is drawn either way. DRIVER — your account, 'I followed the navigation', is consistent with the record, and there is no traffic advisory for this trip: EV-ADVIS-02806-01 is MISSING, carries weight_multiplier 0.0 and issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, and its own detail records that no advisory covers the Northpoint City corridor in this window. Under POL-RD-13 such an assertion cannot be tested against an advisory and carries no weight under POL-RD-08, but that is moot here because the rider's threshold test fails in any event and no exculpatory clause is needed. No POL-RD-06 pattern check arises either: driver_profile.deviation_flags_90d is 0 over 230 completed trips. Billing integrity and integrity of the trace: the fare breakdown itemises 0.00 ERP and tolls, erp_gantries is empty, and the airport surcharge is 0.00 on a trip that neither originates nor ends at an airport, so POL-RD-09(4) has nothing to correct and no referral is produced. The GPS trace is unimpaired for policy purposes (117 fixes at a 10 s interval, 100.0% coverage, empty gaps array, max gap 0.0 s), so POL-RD-07 and POL-RD-10(3) are not engaged, and none of the other POL-RD-10 triggers fires: identifiers match, timestamps agree, no refund exceeds any ceiling, and no charge line is unmatched. NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03 is party-relative: the fare_breakdown stands as it is — payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0 — and nothing is refunded or held. The monetary effect is nil, below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00. Confidence 0.95, resting on EV-GPS-02806 and EV-TRIP-02806, each at weight_multiplier 1.0. The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).

How to appeal: Either party may appeal once within 30 days. A different human reviewer hears it, and only record evidence may be added.

Read POL-GEN-04 in full
Every ruling issued without human review is a provisional ruling. Either party may appeal it once, within 30 days of the trip or of the ruling's issue, whichever is later, by lodging the appeal with the platform's help channel. An appeal (a) is heard by a human reviewer who did not take part in any earlier review of the same trip; (b) may add only record-type evidence - a GPS export, a fare or payment statement, an ERP gantry record with gantry name, entry time and cashcard statement, a call log, a photograph with its capture time - and may not add or amend a party statement; (c) suspends execution of any amount not yet executed and freezes it until decided, and where the amount was executed under POL-GEN-05 before the appeal, a successful appeal reverses it; (d) may not be withdrawn and re-lodged. A second appeal on the same trip, an appeal lodged after 30 days, or an appeal that adds only statements is refused. The appeal decision is recorded as a human closure under POL-GEN-06, enters the precedent store, and is final on the platform. This clause licenses no ruling value: an appeal is a route to human review, not a ruling, and it is lodged after a ruling has issued.
